comment: Invalid documents, each a mutation of packages/schemas/examples/{Project,OpBatch}.json. Every language's test asserts that `checkedBy` lists it. Ajv and Pydantic check every constraint; typify checks types, enums, IDs, patterns, string lengths and integer bounds, but **not float bounds**, so the `checkedBy` of the two float-range cases names only Ajv and Pydantic — `bragi-model::validate` rejects those in WP-0.3. `document` is the whole mutated document, so no test needs a patch engine.

cases.name: unknown-root-field
cases.why: An unknown root field is rejected, never dropped (additionalProperties: false keeps the three languages lossless).

cases.name: unknown-nested-field
cases.why: An unknown field on a nested object is rejected too.

cases.name: bad-hash-length
cases.why: An asset hash that is not `sha256:` + 64 lowercase hex.

cases.name: bad-id-prefix
cases.why: A project ID without its `prj_` type prefix (02 §2.1).

cases.name: missing-required
cases.why: A required root field is missing.

cases.name: wrong-schema-version
cases.why: `schemaVersion` is fixed at 1 (02 §9: removals and renames need `migrate`).

cases.name: bad-timestamp
cases.why: A timestamp that is not RFC 3339 UTC with a `Z` (02 §2.2).

cases.name: wrong-bass-type
cases.why: An array where the schema requires a string map.

cases.name: unknown-op
cases.why: An op whose `op` names nothing in the v1 catalogue is rejected: the union only accepts the 29 known discriminators.

cases.name: op-extra-field
cases.why: An op with a field its payload does not define is rejected (an op is a closed object).

cases.name: pan-out-of-range
cases.why: `pan` outside [-1, 1]. Numeric *float* ranges are checked by Ajv and Pydantic; typify generates `f64` and does not range-check it, so Rust accepts this and `bragi-model::validate` rejects it in WP-0.3. (Integer bounds, by contrast, typify does check.)

cases.name: non-positive-section-length
cases.why: `lengthTicks` must be > 0 (02 §4.3 invariant 2). typify does enforce integer bounds (it generates a checked newtype), unlike float bounds and string lengths.

cases.name: empty-string
cases.why: A `minLength: 1` string (`Automation.target`) must not be empty. typify counts code points, like Pydantic.
